title: Minecraft Drinking
blurb: Three glugs and a swallow. Drinking in Minecraft covers milk, potions and honey, and the sound is the same rapid gulping every time. A very small piece of audio doing a lot of work, since it is your only confirmation that the effect actually applied. Milk in particular is the game's panic button, clearing every status effect in one go, so this clip is often the noise of somebody frantically undoing a mistake. Useful in edits any time a character needs to drink something quickly and slightly desperately.
